name: Bento Grid
summary: A responsive grid of rounded feature cards with numbered eyebrows, spans for wide, tall and full-width cards, a tinted accent area, a hover lift, an in-view stagger entrance and optional spotlight or border-beam card effects.
useWhen: Presenting four to six features on a landing page with uneven card sizes
Showing product highlights that need one wide or tall card for emphasis
Landing sections that want a cursor-tracked spotlight or a travelling border beam on feature cards
avoidWhen: The items are a plain list to scan or act on; use a list or table instead
The cards need to be interactive controls; put buttons in a card grid of your own, since these cards are plain articles
